description: Fetch the current record for one site by id. Use this to poll the status of a build after `create_site` (or a `create_revision`). Returns the full site row including `status`, `generation_phase`, `generation_message`, and (when complete) `deployment_url`.  Polling pattern: call every 2–5 seconds; stop when `status` is `complete` or `failed`. `status` values: `generating` | `complete` | `failed` | `research_review`.  Returns 404 if the site does not exist OR is not owned by your account.
name: get_site
title: Get a Warpweb site
